question:
What should come in place of ? in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

ETM, AWO, WZQ, SCS, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (4) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa221d488b3d72c6466f5ba1d5b7caec8730c5c6c4befa3937ff21c63d27e65a.png] 

Hence, "**OFU**" is the correct answer.
